title: 2026 UK ETS installation permit-transfer QA controls

sources.title: UK ETS for installations: how to comply

facts.fact: The guidance identifies full, partial and amalgamation permit transfers.
A full transfer moves the complete permit from one operator to another.
A partial transfer moves specified transferred units to another operator.
An amalgamation transfer combines two installations on the same site into one permit.
The current and proposed operators jointly apply to the regulator for a transfer.
Transfer applications are submitted using METS.
The new operator must register the new installation in METS.
A change to the legal entity operating an installation triggers the transfer process.
Transfer arrangements must preserve monitoring-plan responsibilities and approved permit conditions.
A business or site change does not itself constitute regulator-approved permit transfer.

guard_patterns.rule: Do not confuse a name-only variation with legal-entity transfer.
Do not treat submission as approval.
